bugs.title: Font 'Inherit from store theme' looks the same as 'Inter' in the live preview
bugs.evidence: check p5-branding-launcher: --gw-font on the preview widget-panel is 'Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif' for Inherit and "'Inter', system-ui, ..." for Inter, so both show Inter. The MiniStore uses Georgia serif, but SupportWidget reads the font from host.parentElement (ShadowRoot onHost, SupportWidget.tsx:354-356). That element is outside the serif mini-store in the preview, so it gets the app's Inter. Frontend-only: there is no backend (mock data). Radius 0/20 and shadow none do change the preview.

action_items.detail: No backend / no /api/openapi.json, per spec_deviations. The backend lane was skipped and there are no backend checks.

checks.criterion: JRN-74..76 layout, preview toggles, save/discard/guard, preview on store
checks.name: p5-widget-settings-save-guard
checks.evidence: 6 sections, 3 pages, 3 devices, 8 states, iPhone frame. The title appears in the preview instantly; unsaved bar, Discard reverts, 'Widget settings saved' shows, 'Discard unsaved changes?' guard appears. Popup /widget-demo?desk_preview=1 shows the banner and its widget shadow root has --gw-primary #AA2233 (the draft).

checks.name: p5-branding-launcher
checks.evidence: Passed: hex error + Save aria-disabled, preset, 'Contrast x:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1', PNG thumb + preview logo, gif error, radius/shadow, hat, pill empty-label error + label shows in preview, S<L size, bottom-left, offset, mobile offset only moves the launcher in Mobile, badge color, animation options + bounce input. Failed: font inherit vs Inter (see bug).
